title: Solo Signal: useful judgment without fake independence

ciFast.note: Fast verification must run on the pushed v0.16.14 candidate before merge.

ciDeep.note: Founder review is deliberately non-independent. It does not replace qualified held-out instructor review, adapter comparison, or device evidence.

deploy.note: Deployment is not claimed until the exact merged commit passes Pages.

liveProvider.note: This release changes offline evaluation workflow only. It makes no provider call and changes no model, adapter, prompt, or hosted inference route.

manualHuman.note: The solo-founder form is ready, but no completed founder export is counted in this release and qualified independent instructor reviews remain zero.

claims.summary: Each domain packet now provides separate instructor and founder pages over the same hash-bound blind cases, with evidence-specific copy, templates, and attestations.
The offline reviewer shows one case at a time with progress, back and next navigation, direct jumps, flags, and local autosave while preserving zero-network operation.
Founder exports are protocol-bound, non-independent, conflict-declared, and claim-ineligible, and they remain invalid under the working-instructor validator and ingestion path.
Founder judgments may drive compiler diagnosis and non-promotable research, but cannot enter the approved production corpus, satisfy independent review, or promote an adapter.
The release changes evaluation workflow only; hosted Scion remains base-only and no approved training pair, qualified adapter win, or device result is claimed.
